verdict.rationale: Metorial documents separate environments. Each has its own provider deployments, API keys, auth configs, and logs, so sandbox changes do not affect production. This is a direct, first-party sandbox capability, but it rests on a single docs sentence that covers configuration isolation rather than proving test runs never touch production data in connected third-party systems. missing for 10: in-depth docs on sandbox environment setup and usage, evidence of data isolation from live third-party accounts during sandbox tests, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Each environment has its own provider deployments, API keys, authentication configs, and logs, so changes in a sandbox do not affect production.
